pages.text: Spells live in spellbooks. Bind a scroll into one at an $(item)Inscription Table$() (there's one in Firelink's chapel).
pages.title: Spellbooks

pages.text: A spellbook only works $(l)equipped$(): open your Curios slots with $(l)'$() (or the button in your inventory) and put it in the $(l)Spellbook$() slot.$(br2)Then cast with $(l)mouse side button 5$(), and pick spells from the wheel on $(l)side button 4$().
Necromancy is Goety's business: souls power its wands. Its focus wand is on $(l)Z$(), the focus wheel on $(l)=$().$(br2)Scrolls cast once and crumble. Spellbooks remember.
